call.text: Recurrent models factor computation along the symbol positions of the input and output sequences, generating each hidden state h_t as a function of the previous hidden state h_t‑1 and the input at position t, which makes the computation inherently sequential and thus precludes parallelization within training examples [AIAYN:1:c002]. This sequential nature becomes especially critical at longer sequence lengths because memory constraints then limit the ability to batch across examples, amplifying the inefficiency [AIAYN:1:c002].
